name: Capability SDK pin/typecheck
pass_condition: Real installed SDK+daemon discovery and unsupported capability blocked

name: Sandbox boundary
pass_condition: Outside-path secret network and child-spawn escapes rejected

name: Plan contract
pass_condition: Missing required data and cyclic dependencies rejected

name: State invariants
pass_condition: SKIPPED not accepted; cancelled cannot resume; graph valid

name: Duplicate command
pass_condition: Same key same result; altered payload conflict

name: Atomic intent
pass_condition: Attempt reservation outbox event commit or rollback together

name: Reservation contention
pass_condition: Parallel connections cannot exceed budget or capacity

name: Ambiguous spawn
pass_condition: Crash after start before bind reconcile or UNKNOWN; no blind second spawn

name: Runtime finish
pass_condition: Idle is turn-only; timeout not cancel; permission waits

name: Scoped cancellation
pass_condition: Only intended session/subtree; observed ack required

name: Candidate freeze
pass_condition: Evaluator sees exact candidate hash; mutable source cannot change tested output

name: Protected suite
pass_condition: Worker cannot tamper evaluator or forge trusted receipt

name: Acceptance negative control
pass_condition: Exit 0/zero tests/forged success fail the gate

name: Manager to actual run
pass_condition: Draft human approve real worker evidence and bounded repair complete

name: Budget exhausted
pass_condition: No repair/spawn after ceiling without scoped operator extension

name: Stop latch
pass_condition: STOP survives process restart; clear latch does not revive terminal run

name: Local auth
pass_condition: GET/SSE/write auth; Host Origin CSRF and session revoke

name: SSE catch-up
pass_condition: Snapshot cursor no lost/duplicate update; old cursor resync

name: Scoped UI
pass_condition: Selected capsule composer evidence and decisions never cross scope

name: State truth
pass_condition: Unknown disconnected cancel-requested not shown accepted/cancelled

name: Mobile keyboard
pass_condition: 390px no page overflow; forms labels focus and keyboard tabs

name: Parallel isolation
pass_condition: Two capsules separate candidates and evaluator outputs

name: Lease fencing
pass_condition: Stale attempt result cannot commit; expiry alone not respawn

name: Fair resources
pass_condition: Manager/evaluator/bench counted; awaiting approval frees known finished slot

name: Fault matrix
pass_condition: Provider 429/auth/death duplicate event and disk-full safe paths

name: Backup restore
pass_condition: Consistent DB+artifact restore paused; external state reconciled

name: Partial cancel
pass_condition: Cancel one capsule does not stop other or auto revert completed side effect

name: Read-only completion
pass_condition: No eval/shell/file side effect; unsupported coder remains blocked

name: Trial provenance
pass_condition: Snapshot prompt/profile/policy/evaluator/environment hashes per trial

name: Benchmark arithmetic
pass_condition: Failed/timeout remain denominator; unknown cost not zero

name: Paired fair runs
pass_condition: Identical cases/budgets randomized order and repeats; evidence inspectable

name: Profile rollout
pass_condition: Human-approved version canary and regression rollback

name: Release provenance
pass_condition: Pinned deps/license/SBOM and known limit report

name: Operational ownership
pass_condition: Service safe shutdown disk pressure and escalation owner documented

name: Reservation mutation gates
pass_condition: UPDATE cannot raise active reservation past run ceiling nor flip UNKNOWN to ACTIVE while STOP latched

name: Minimum result fence
pass_condition: S1: stale attempt/epoch result rejected at commit; expiry alone not respawn proof (full lease/fence stays A23/S3)
